knitr::opts_chunk$set(

## Overview

This vignette shows the canonical **rwarp** workflow for reprojecting a
Sentinel-2 Band 4 COG tile from its native UTM projection (EPSG:32755) to US
Albers Equal Area (EPSG:5070).

The workflow has three steps:

1. **Plan** — call `warp_plan()` to compute the source window(s) needed.
   This is pure geometry: no data is read yet.
2. **Read** — supply a reader function.  Here we use `gdalraster::GDALRaster`,
   but the same function signature works for byte-ref COG tiles, Zarr chunks, etc.
3. **Execute** — call `warp_exec()` with the plan and reader.

```{r libraries}
library(rwarp)
library(gdalraster)
library(vaster)
library(reproj)
```

## Source raster

We use a public Sentinel-2 COG from the Element 84 Earth Search STAC.  The
`/vsicurl/` prefix lets GDAL stream range requests without downloading the file.

```{r source}
url <- paste0(
  "/vsicurl/https://e84-earth-search-sentinel-data.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com",
  "/sentinel-2-c1-l2a/55/G/CM/2026/2/S2C_T55GCM_20260227T000650_L2A/B04.tif"
)

ds      <- new(GDALRaster, url, read_only = TRUE)
src_crs <- ds$getProjectionRef()
src_gt  <- ds$getGeoTransform()
src_dim <- c(ds$getRasterXSize(), ds$getRasterYSize())
nodata  <- ds$getNoDataValue(1L)
if (is.na(nodata)) nodata <- 0L

cat("Source CRS:", substr(src_crs, 1, 40), "...\n")
cat("Source geotransform:", paste(src_gt, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Source dimensions:", src_dim, "\n")
```

## Destination grid

We reproject the bounding box of the source tile into EPSG:5070 and build a
destination geotransform at 10 m resolution.

```{r destination}
dst_crs  <- "EPSG:5070"

## Reproject the source bounding box into the destination CRS
bbox_ll  <- ds$bbox()[c(1, 3, 2, 4)]   # c(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
dst_ext  <- reproj_extent(bbox_ll, target = dst_crs, source = src_crs)
cat("Destination extent (EPSG:5070):", dst_ext, "\n")

## 10-metre pixels; round up to whole pixels
dst_dim  <- as.integer(ceiling(diff(dst_ext[c(1, 2, 3, 4)][c(1, 3)] * c(1, -1)) / 10))
dst_dim  <- as.integer(c(
  ceiling((dst_ext[2] - dst_ext[1]) / 10),
  ceiling((dst_ext[4] - dst_ext[3]) / 10)
))
dst_gt   <- extent_dim_to_gt(dst_ext, dst_dim)
cat("Destination dimensions:", dst_dim, "\n")
```

## Step 1: Plan

`warp_plan()` computes all source windows needed to fill the destination
without touching the file.  Inspect it before committing to I/O.

```{r plan}
plan <- warp_plan(
  src_crs  = src_crs, src_gt  = src_gt,  src_dim = as.integer(src_dim),
  dst_crs  = dst_crs, dst_gt  = dst_gt,
  dst_off  = c(0L, 0L), dst_size = as.integer(dst_dim),
  resample_padding = 1L
)

cat("Number of chunk-lists:", length(plan), "\n")
for (i in seq_along(plan)) {
  for (j in seq_along(plan[[i]])) {
    ch <- plan[[i]][[j]]
    cat(sprintf(
      "  [%d][%d] src window [%d,%d] %dx%d  fill=%.3f\n",
      i, j, ch$src_xoff, ch$src_yoff, ch$src_xsize, ch$src_ysize, ch$fill_ratio
    ))
  }
}
```

## Step 2: Define the read function

The read function has a fixed signature `f(xoff, yoff, xsize, ysize)` and
returns an integer vector in row-major order.  Swap this out for any other
source (byte-ref tiles, Zarr, etc.) without changing the plan or execute steps.

```{r read_fn}
read_fn <- function(xoff, yoff, xsize, ysize) {
  as.integer(
    ds$read(1L, xoff = xoff, yoff = yoff,
            xsize = xsize, ysize = ysize,
            out_xsize = xsize, out_ysize = ysize)
  )
}
```

## Step 3: Execute

```{r execute}
result <- warp_exec(
  plan      = plan,
  read_fn   = read_fn,
  src_crs   = src_crs, src_gt = src_gt,
  dst_crs   = dst_crs, dst_gt = dst_gt,
  dst_size  = as.integer(dst_dim),
  nodata    = as.integer(nodata),
  resample  = "near",
  verbose   = TRUE
)

cat("Result range:", range(result, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

## Visualise

```{r visualise, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
## Mask nodata (0 = swath edge; out-of-bounds pixels are already NA)
result[result <= 0L] <- NA

if (requireNamespace("ximage", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ximage::ximage(result, dst_ext,
    main = "Sentinel-2 B04 reprojected to EPSG:5070 (Albers)",
    col  = grey.colors(256))
} else {
  image(result, main = "Sentinel-2 B04 (EPSG:5070)")
}

ds$close()
```

## Verification: compare with GDAL warp

```{r verify, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
tf <- tempfile(tmpdir = "/vsimem", fileext = ".tif")
ds2 <- new(GDALRaster, url, read_only = TRUE)
gdalraster::warp(ds2, tf, t_srs = dst_crs,
  cl_arg = c("-ts", dst_dim, "-te", dst_ext[c(1, 3, 2, 4)], "-r", "near")
)
wds <- new(GDALRaster, tf)
gdal_result <- matrix(read_ds(wds), nrow = dst_dim[2L], ncol = dst_dim[1L])
wds$close()
ds2$close()

gdal_result[gdal_result <= 0L] <- NA

if (requireNamespace("ximage", quietly = TRUE)) {
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
  ximage::ximage(result,      dst_ext, main = "rwarp",      col = grey.colors(256))
  ximage::ximage(gdal_result, dst_ext, main = "GDAL warp",  col = grey.colors(256))
}
```
